headings.instruction: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. Use Manrope for high-energy but readable numbers and titles.

body.instruction: Use IBM Plex Sans for dense data rows, expense lists, and details.

dashboard_cards.style: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm

payment_banner.style: bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between

list_items.style: flex items-center justify-between py-3 border-b border-stone-100 last:border-0

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-stone-200 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl py-3 px-6 font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: bg-stone-100 text-slate-900 rounded-xl py-3 px-6 font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-transform
buttons.accent: bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-xl py-3 px-6 font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-transform

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2.5 for a bolder, athletic feel.

image_urls.description: A dynamic cheerleading squad holding silver pompoms, capturing the spirit and energy of the sport.
Group of suitcases, representing competition travel and hotel bookings.
Empty stadium under clear blue sky, representing competition venues.

motion_and_interactions.buttons: Active state scale down (active:scale-95) to mimic mobile app tactile feedback.
motion_and_interactions.lists: Use staggered fade-in for expense and travel lists.
motion_and_interactions.navigation: Smooth slide transitions between main views.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI as a mobile-first web app mimicking a native Expo app using React JS (.js) and Tailwind CSS.
Implement views for: Dashboard, Athletes Management, Expenses Tracker, Payments Tracker, Competitions, Travel & Accommodations, Reminders, and Fundraisers.
Use standard DOM elements (div, span) styled as mobile components (bottom tabs, sticky headers).
Implement a bottom navigation bar fixed to the bottom to switch between main views.
Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) for the main app background; use bg-stone-50 to reduce glare and make white cards pop.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Do not use Shadcn card components if they restrict custom spacing; use raw divs with the defined dashboard_cards styles.
Use tabular-nums for all currency amounts and align them right in list views.
Use the provided image URLs for empty states or header backgrounds. Do NOT use placeholder services.
